texts: good. the maintenance reading comes through exactly — the records are kept, not altered, the secrecy is recorded as a state that continues, and secrecy is handed to each record by a rule rather than being predicated of the set as an object.

good. the "never" comes through as the denial that any past opening happened, while the records' typing and their secrecy correctly stay outside the denial; the word "never" itself leaves no separate trace, which costs nothing here.
